name: mcpack-deobfuscator
name_Chinese: 我的世界基岩版资源包反混淆工具
description: Deobfuscate Minecraft Bedrock edition resource packs (mcpack; a mcpack is a ZIP archive with a .mcpack extension) protected or obfuscated by PackSquash tools, and verify their integrity.
description_Chinese: 反混淆被 PackSquash 工具混淆/保护的 Minecraft 基岩版资源包（mcpack；mcpack 就是换扩展名的 ZIP），并校验其完整性。
